accepted_findings: Twenty-five protocol/software checks pass on already exposed probes plus an explicitly synthetic boundary unit fixture.

Equal pretoken occurrence budgets do not equalize author initial symbol mass; en/fr/es masses are 1418/1315/1429 for the 256-unit diagnostic.

Atomically generate and verify selected-row manifests with fixed shard provenance.
Lock wheel hashes, Python and platform.
